_doc: Loot scaling. Quality centre = 1 + (tier-1)*quality_per_tier + gamestage*quality_per_gamestage + bias + the looter's loot_quality_bonus (Keen, Scavenger; whole points also lift the Q ceiling).
_quality_doc: Quality tiers 1..6: names and colours shown in the salvage roll. Q also scales weapon damage (0.85 + 0.1 Q) and durability (0.75 + 0.15 Q).
